name: Anzaki Kaoru
source:
She is a reincarnated body of "Serahime" who received a curse, but she has no memory of her previous life. Her parents were killed right in front of her, but her bright and lively personality would convince you otherwise. She is good at sports in general, and boasts exceptional strength in kendo, which she learned from her foster father, who is her instructor.

Until Ren appeared, she had a life without love. While hesitating and suffering, she eats people's sins and searches for her own way of life through battle.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ignote.net/operetta/tumikui/character.html]official website[/url]]
